newsitem.title: UK: Tipco Asphalt sets $70 mln Euroconvertible.
newsitem.headline: Tipco Asphalt sets $70 mln Euroconvertible.

text.p: Tipco Asphalt has issued a $70 million Euroconvertible bond with an approximate 10-year maturity, lead manager Paribas Capital Markets said.

The coupon is indicated at 2.50 percent to 3.0 percent. There is a greenshoe option of around $10 million. The bond is convertible into Foreign Board shares of the company. The premium is indicated at 10 percent to 15 percent to the domestic share price.
There is a put in year five to yield 110-160 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
Two-year hard no call, the issue is callable at par thereafter, subject to a 140 percent call hurdle.
